name: Butterfly Effects
evidence_note: ABA therapy (in-home, center, school). Its services and sitemap list ABA skills assessments and therapy, no diagnostic evaluations.

name: Kyo
evidence_note: ABA therapy for autistic children. Kyo's FAQ says the formal diagnosis comes from the child's physician; its services list no diagnostic evaluations.

name: Proud Moments ABA
evidence_note: ABA therapy. Its site says ABA requires an autism diagnosis from an outside clinician ('Get a Diagnosis'); it lists no diagnostic evaluations.
